### 2.2 — Bearers: physical layer and frequencies (~2 slides)

#### Slide: Classic VHF ACARS (POA)

- **Frequencies**: 131.525 / 131.725 / 131.825 / 130.025 MHz (region-dependent)
- **Modulation**: MSK (Minimum Shift Keying), **2400 bps**, *continuous* transmission
- No time-slotting; CSMA-style channel access
- The audible "duck quack" on a VHF scanner — sounds the same since 1978
- Decoded by: `acars131` frontend (`crates/acars/src/demod/acars131.rs`)
- Also: SATCOM L-band (Inmarsat ~1.5 GHz, global, requires dish) and HF (HFDL, oceanic)

#### Slide: VDL Mode 2

- **Frequencies**: 136.725 / 136.775 / 136.875 / **136.975 MHz** (CSC — Common Signalling
  Channel, globally monitored)
- **Modulation**: D8PSK (Differential 8-Phase Shift Keying), **10.5 kbaud**, *burst*
- Each burst:
  ```
  ramp-up  →  training sequence  →  FEC + interleaved payload  →  ramp-down
  ```
- Training sequence: known bit pattern for symbol sync and channel estimation
- Convolutional FEC + bit interleaving: protects against burst errors
- Decoded by: `vdl136` frontend (`crates/acars/src/demod/vdl2.rs`)

| | Classic ACARS | VDL Mode 2 |
|--|--------------|------------|
| Band | 129–131 MHz | 136–137 MHz |
| Modulation | MSK continuous | D8PSK burst |
| Bitrate | 2 400 bps | ~31 500 bps |
| Link layer | none | AVLC (HDLC-derived) |
| Network layer | none | X.25 / CLNP / COTP |
